name: backend-huellitas
description: API para gestión de veterinaria Huellitas Saludables

scripts.migrate: sequelize-cli db:migrate --config app/config/config.js --models-path app/models --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders
scripts.migrate:undo: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo --config app/config/config.js --models-path app/models --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders
scripts.migrate:undo:all: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all --config app/config/config.js --models-path app/models --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders
scripts.seed: sequelize-cli db:seed:all --config app/config/config.js --models-path app/models --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders
scripts.seed:undo: sequelize-cli db:seed:undo:all --config app/config/config.js --models-path app/models --migrations-path migrations --seeders-path seeders
scripts.db:reset: npm run migrate:undo:all && npm run migrate && npm run seed
